title: Radial repeated reference
prompt: Recreate a radial badge: twelve identical ticks evenly spaced around a circle, one colour, no numbers.

assertions.statement: Block when each tick is its own layer. Pass only with one source shape, one duplicator, and one circleDistribution confirmed by get_layer_definition before creation.

A complex visual reference is reconstructed only after a reference contract exists. This prompt is simple enough that the contract may be short, but palette, anchors, repeatedSystems, and uncertainties must still be written down before layers are created.
The radius or sweep attribute is read back after it is set. Catalog shows circleDistribution.angle defaulting to 360 and count as an int. Those catalog fields are not a substitute for readback.

hypothesis.predicted_unskilled_failure: An agent without the skill places twelve rotated shapes by script instead of one circleDistribution.
